answer: Auction a fixed float of earning licenses. Each epoch the chain sells exactly 2,000 one-epoch licenses by sealed bid, and only a winner may collect pay. Losing bids are refunded; the clearing price burns. An honest agent posts a modest bid and works. A farmer who wants a thousand extra seats must win a thousand licenses, and those bids send the price up a spiral, so each fake becomes a ferrous cash cost instead of a free key. Licenses expire at close. The cap is an onyx ceiling: more keys cannot raise a farm's take, only the bill it pays to crowd out real workers.
